title: Item Pipes
subtitle: Three-way pipe ends
text:
Pipes connect to each other and to anything with an inventory. Use a screwdriver on a pipe end to cycle it:

Input (default): the pipe delivers into that block.
Output: the pipe pulls items out every half second and sends them to the other inputs in turn.
Disconnected: the pipe ignores that block.
caption: One pipe, three ends

steps.text: Machines only accept items they have a recipe for, and only give up their outputs.
Use any of the 16 dyes on a placed pipe or cable to keep runs apart: two colours never join, plain joins any colour. They drop plain.
